product_one_liner.value: Aurora Solar provides cloud-based software for solar installers and sales teams to design photovoltaic systems, model energy production, and create proposals to sell solar projects.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 302 employees; PitchBook reports 323, both within this band.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts by Senior Software Engineer Kyle Maxwell and Senior Computer Vision Engineer Adriel Luo explain product graphics implementation and internally developed AI models.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The public board lists seven openings, with no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title; Staff Analytics Engineer does not qualify.

model_provider.value: Aurora Solar’s internally developed AI and computer-vision models
model_provider.notes: Aurora explicitly says its team created the models customers use through Aurora AI. A reproduction of its current subprocessor list names Anthropic and OpenAI, but does not establish which customer-facing product features use them; no specific external model version is confirmed.

compliance_certs.notes: These are public compliance claims reproduced from the company’s trust center as observed November 3, 2026; GDPR is a regulatory alignment claim, not a certification. The trust center itself was not readable.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round is February 2022, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Mid-Market Account Executive posting is listed on the current official job board.

launched_6mo.notes: The September 22, 2026 announcement introduced home-electrification proposals, expanded financing options and other platform capabilities, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying company join or departure by a C-level or VP executive was verified for November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026; the available leadership information did not establish a complete dated roster. Internal promotions were not treated as company joins.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Salesforce is named for pipeline forecasting in the current account-executive posting. Aurora’s published subprocessor PDF identifies Salesforce and HubSpot as CRM providers; that PDF was last updated October 12, 2023.
